source: SIMBAD (CDS) preferred ICRS J2000 positions and parallaxes
distance_derivation: distance_pc = 1000 / parallax_mas; valid because every committed parallax is positive
membership_join: target_id is star_params_key when present, otherwise website_slug, from data/catalog/system_catalog.csv
notes: Alpha Centauri A and B share the system parallax selected by SIMBAD; their distinct component positions remain truthful and nearly coincident at neighborhood scale.
The first six fixed-star positions reuse the already committed RYA-952 SIMBAD astrometry values; RYA-1065 extends the same source convention to every registered system.
Gliese 581 uses Gaia DR3 parallax 158.7183 +/- 0.0300 mas, bibliography 2020yCat.1350....0G.
